claims.evidence: Neither photo shows the machine powered on, running a sewing cycle, or any output sample; only static views are given, so operational claim cannot be confirmed or denied from the report.

risks.risk: Machine may not actually power on or complete a sewing cycle correctly, despite the claim
risks.proof: Video clip of the machine switched on, needle arms cycling, and a sewn booklet sample coming off the output tray
risks.if_unproven: price as non-working / for-parts until a running demonstration is shown

risks.risk: Visible rust on the feed tray and outdoor storage on bare ground suggest corrosion or moisture exposure to internal mechanics not visible in the photos
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the feed tray underside, drive pulley, and internal clamp arms, plus confirmation of how long it sat outdoors
risks.if_unproven: price as needing refurbishment/derusting until clean internals are shown

risks.risk: No manufacturer nameplate, brand, or model visible, so exact make/value tier is unknown
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate/data plate with brand, model, and serial number
risks.if_unproven: price as generic/unbranded unit until nameplate is confirmed

risks.risk: Electrical specification (voltage/phase/power) unknown, affecting usability in Lagos without rewiring or a stabilizer/transformer
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate or a multimeter/clamp-meter reading during operation
risks.if_unproven: price assuming extra cost for electrical adaptation until specs are confirmed

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (needles, thread guides, bobbins) not shown, and two photos appear to show the machine in two different settings (outdoor bare ground vs indoor painted wall), raising a possibility of mismatched or stock images
risks.proof: A single video walk-around showing the same machine, same serial/nameplate, in one consistent location, including all accessories laid out
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete/unverified-unit listing until one-take video confirms it is the same single machine with full accessories

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on, completing a full sewing/stitching cycle with a sample output
Close-up photo of the manufacturer nameplate/data plate (brand, model, serial, voltage)
Close-up photos of feed tray underside, pulley, and clamp arms showing extent of rust
Photo or video showing all included accessories (needles, thread guides, bobbins, manual)
A single continuous video showing the same unit in one location to confirm photos 0 and 1 are the same machine
response.reason: The witness reliably identifies an industrial bookbinding sewing machine, but working condition, electrical specs, completeness, and even consistency between the two photos are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
